approved_payload.content: Delft police registered a double murder case after two men were shot dead in Camdeboo Street, Anceba Court, Voorbrug, at about 18:40 on Saturday 3 October; both were declared dead at the scene and the motive is unknown (police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). Both outlets carry the same police statement.

checked.basis: Both reports rest on the same police statement; not independent confirmation.
checked.location: Camdeboo Street, Anceba Court, Voorbrug, Delft (exact spot not given). OpenStreetMap has the street as Camdeboo Crescent; the pin is on it.
checked.method: Collected by google_news_collector --keywords; source pages read and claims, dates and place checked by hand. Both sources quote the same police statement; IOL/Cape Argus reprinted the Daily Voice text and is not listed. Standalone (no case, entity or map line).
